{\large Functions and Their Graphs}\par

{\small Ron Larson and Robert P. Hostetler, \emph{Precalculus with Limits}, 2nd ed., p. 1. Tick each box as you go.}\par
\vspace{6pt}
\begin{infobox}
Work through the four parts in order: read each section, practise the matching Duolingo units, work the book-only topics that Duolingo does not cover, then finish the chapter. Duolingo units are grouped by lane (a grade or a topic in the app) and listed in the order the app shows them, so you can follow one lane from top to bottom. \textbf{full} = the unit practises the section's main skill, \textbf{partial} = part of it, \textbf{prereq} = a warm-up from an earlier grade.
\end{infobox}
\textbf{In this chapter:} Grade 9 carries the basics (functions, lines, transformations), grade 11 repeats them at precalculus depth, and the Algebraic Graphing topic is a condensed walk through the whole chapter. Follow grade 11 if you only have time for one lane.

\section{3.\quad Section by section}
For each section: what Duolingo covers (the units are ticked off in part 2) and the book-only topics to work in the textbook. Tick each book-only topic once you have worked examples of it.
\subsection{1.1 Rectangular Coordinates\tagright{p. 2}}
Distance and midpoint are covered in grade 10. Plotting is a lower-grade prerequisite. The section's data applications are book only.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 6:} 33. Plot points in all quadrants (prereq)\\ \textbf{Grade 10:} 50. Line segment midpoint (full); 51. Distance formula (full)\\ \textbf{Geometry:} 11. Absolute value and distance (prereq)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item Translating points in the plane
  \item Applications of the distance and midpoint formulas
\end{checks}
\subsection{1.2 Graphs of Equations\tagright{p. 13}}
Intercepts and circles are covered; symmetry tests and point-plotting of general equations are book only.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 9:} 20. Vertical intercept of functions (partial); 21. Horizontal intercept of functions (partial)\\ \textbf{Grade 10:} 10. Reflectional symmetry (prereq); 47. Circles on the plane (full)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item Symmetry tests (x-axis, y-axis, origin)
  \item Sketching graphs of general equations by point plotting
\end{checks}
\subsection{1.3 Linear Equations in Two Variables\tagright{p. 24}}
Well covered. Grade 8 builds slope and parallel/perpendicular lines, grade 9 the forms of a line, grade 10 point-slope form.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 8:} 21. Intro to slope (prereq); 22. Slope formula (prereq); 24. Slope-intercept form (prereq); 28. Equations of parallel lines (full); 29. Equations of perpendicular lines (full)\\ \textbf{Grade 9:} 5. Slope-intercept form of linear equations (full); 7. Standard form of linear equations (full)\\ \textbf{Grade 10:} 45. Lines in point-slope form (full); 46. Lines in different forms (full)\\ \textbf{Algebraic Graphing:} 3. Slope (partial); 4. Slope-intercept lines (partial)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item Slope as a rate of change in applications
\end{checks}
\subsection{1.4 Functions\tagright{p. 39}}
Function definition, notation, domain, and piecewise functions are covered. The difference quotient is book only.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 8:} 36. Intro to functions (prereq)\\ \textbf{Grade 9:} 17. Inputs and outputs (full); 25. Domain of a function (full); 26. Range of a function (partial); 28. Equations of piecewise functions (full)\\ \textbf{Algebraic Graphing:} 8. Function notation (full); 9. Piecewise-defined functions (full)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item The difference quotient
  \item Writing a function from a word problem
\end{checks}
\subsection{1.5 Analyzing Graphs of Functions\tagright{p. 54}}
Domain and range from graphs, zeros, relative extrema, and average rate of change are covered. Even and odd functions and the vertical line test are book only.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 9:} 18. Graphs of functions (full); 23. Average rate of change (full); 27. Graphs of piecewise functions (full)\\ \textbf{Grade 11:} 3. Compare function graphs (full); 13. Relative maxima and minima of polynomial functions (partial)\\ \textbf{Grade 12:} 17. Domain and range (full)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item Even and odd functions
  \item The Vertical Line Test
\end{checks}
\subsection{1.6 A Library of Parent Functions\tagright{p. 66}}
Grade 11's Function families is the closest match to the parent-function library. Step and absolute value functions are drilled separately.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 9:} 24. Linear functions (prereq); 30. Step functions (full); 31. Absolute value functions (full)\\ \textbf{Grade 11:} 2. Function families (full)\\ \textbf{Algebraic Graphing:} 10. Step and absolute value functions (full)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item The square root and reciprocal parent functions in detail
\end{checks}
\subsection{1.7 Transformations of Functions\tagright{p. 73}}
Fully covered. Grade 9 drills each transformation; grade 11 repeats them with reflections added. Do grade 11 if time is short.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 9:} 75. Vertical translations (full); 76. Horizontal translations (full); 77. Vertical stretches (full); 78. Vertical compressions (full); 79. Horizontal stretches (full); 80. Horizontal compressions (full)\\ \textbf{Grade 11:} 9. Transform absolute value functions (full); 69. Vertical translations (full); 70. Horizontal translations (full); 71. X-axis function reflections (full); 72. Y-axis function reflections (full); 73. Vertical stretches (full); 74. Vertical compressions (full); 75. Horizontal stretches (full); 76. Horizontal compressions (full)\\ \textbf{Algebraic Graphing:} 24. Function translations (full); 25. Vertical function scaling (full); 26. Horizontal function scaling (full); 27. Reflections of functions (full)}\par
\subsection{1.8 Combinations of Functions: Composite Functions\tagright{p. 83}}
Arithmetic combinations and composition are covered. Finding the domain of a composite and decomposing a function are lighter in the app than in the book.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 11:} 67. Combine functions (full); 68. Function composition (full)\\ \textbf{Grade 12:} 13. Function composition (full)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item Domain of a composite function
  \item Decomposing a function into two simpler functions
\end{checks}
\subsection{1.9 Inverse Functions\tagright{p. 92}}
Finding and graphing inverses is covered in grades 9, 11, and 12. The horizontal line test and one-to-one functions are book only.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 9:} 33. Graphs of inverse functions (partial); 34. Equations of inverse functions (partial); 35. Graphs of inverse linear functions (prereq); 36. Equations of inverse linear functions (prereq)\\ \textbf{Grade 11:} 65. Inverse function equations (full); 66. Inverse function graphs (full)\\ \textbf{Grade 12:} 14. Inverse functions (full); 18. Graphing inverses (full)\\ \textbf{Algebraic Graphing:} 23. Inverse linear functions (partial)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item One-to-one functions and the Horizontal Line Test
\end{checks}
\subsection{1.10 Mathematical Modeling and Variation\tagright{p. 102}}
Least squares and linear models are covered in grade 9 and the Statistics topic. Direct variation has a grade 7 prerequisite; inverse and joint variation are book only.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 7:} 7. Proportionality in equations (prereq)\\ \textbf{Grade 9:} 81. Scatter plots (partial); 82. Correlation (partial); 83. Linear models (partial); 84. Residuals (partial)\\ \textbf{Statistics:} 15. Linear models (partial); 16. Linear model fitness (partial)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item Inverse, joint, and combined variation
  \item Least squares regression on the calculator
\end{checks}
